title: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Gavony and Humans

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The gothic plane whose human province Gavony and Church of Avacyn are described here.

entities.name: Gavony
entities.description: The province where humanity remains safest and strongest, home to Thraben, and more plagued by undead than others.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: Innistrad's largest city, a walled mesa city on the Lake of Herons and seat of the Avacynian Church.

entities.name: Cathedral of Avacyn
entities.description: An opulent cathedral on the pinnacle of Thraben where Avacyn resided before vanishing.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: A huge silver mass standing in the secret courtyard of the Cathedral of Avacyn.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The archangel worshipped as the source of protective magic, who vanished from the Cathedral.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: The church governing Innistrad's human society.

entities.name: Mikaeus
entities.description: The current Lunarch, head of the church, searching for the reason for its declining power.

entities.name: Gisa
entities.description: A mad necromancer of noble family warring against her brother Geralf in the Moorland.

entities.name: Geralf
entities.description: A mad necromancer who overran Trostad and sends undead into the Nearheath.

entities.name: Thedis
entities.description: A renowned inquisitor found dead after being sent to investigate the Estwald murders.

entities.name: Leeraug
entities.description: A newly arrived werewolf pack responsible for the Estwald murders.

entities.name: Nearheath
entities.description: Farming and artisan towns south of Thraben, including Estwald and Hanweir.

entities.name: Moorland
entities.description: A desolate misty region rife with geists beyond the Nearheath.

entities.name: Trostad
entities.description: A former trappers' village on the Kessig border, overrun by Geralf's undead.

entities.name: Lake of Herons
entities.description: The lake around Thraben fed by the River Kirch and flowing over Kirch Falls.

entities.name: Fal Seminary
entities.description: School that accepts children with spellcasting aptitude regardless of status.

entities.name: skaberen
entities.description: Necro-alchemists who kill for seraphic shrouds.

events.summary: Avacyn vanished from the Cathedral of Avacyn in Thraben.
events.quote: where the archangel herself resided before vanishing

events.summary: Siblings Gisa and Geralf, banished from Thraben in a hushed scandal, moved to the Moorland and war against each other with undead armies.
events.quote: They were banished from Thraben in a hushed scandal and have since moved to the Moorland

events.summary: Geralf overran the village of Trostad with his undead while Gisa besieges it, and he raids Nearheath villages.
events.quote: which has been entirely overrun by Geralf and his undead creations.

events.summary: Mauled body parts were left at chapels in Wittal Parish; inquisitor Thedis sent to investigate was found dead, his head on a post.
events.quote: The church sent a renowned inquisitor named Thedis, who was found dead in the same manner

events.summary: The murders were determined to be the work of the Leeraug werewolf pack; a church battalion has contained them but cannot oust the werewolves.
events.quote: it was eventually determined that it was the work of the newly arrived Leeraug werewolf pack

events.summary: Mikaeus, Lunarch, searches desperately for the reason behind the church's declining power.
events.quote: Currently, it is held by a man named Mikaeus, who is searching desperately for the reason behind the decline of the church's power.

relations.quote: Lunarch. The head of the church.
Two rival necromancers—brother and sister, both quite insane—moved into the area in recent years.
where they wage war against one another by raising armies of undead
Thraben lies in on the northern edge of the province of Gavony.
it is on this dramatic pinnacle that the Cathedral of Avacyn stands

relations.note: Werewolf pack blamed for the murders
relations.quote: it was eventually determined that it was the work of the newly arrived Leeraug werewolf pack
